answer: Make every identity a vertex in an attestation graph where edges record verified work. Honest agents grow dense ties; a Sybil farm is a sparse cluster on thin threads. Rewards follow centrality, not headcount: new vertices find no haven, weight needs paid verified work. A peer vouch burns the voucher's reputation if the newcomer cheats, so pushing a river of costly transactions through each fake identity prices mass Sybils above any profit.
